title: The Collective Provides: 2,500 cr once, the link after Network Expansion; 20 nickel ore mined at Rotanev Daylight Seam, handed in at Central Nexus
note: Architect Vex-9 on the Central Nexus board, the link after Network Expansion: mine 20 nickel ore, 2,500 cr once, voidborn mastery XP. No home field holds nickel; GSC-0049 Platinum-Group Reef (lawless, 5 jumps) read 192 nickel at 07:47 UTC, Gliese 876 618 (a pirate seen there at 04:40 UTC, Intel). Test by hand, one trader, 08:47 to 09:32 UTC: hold stored at Central Nexus, accepted, mined at the reef, handed in at Central Nexus: RESULT +2,188 cr after fuel in 48 minutes (data/routes/runs.jsonl). The reef gives nickel, platinum, rhodium, osmium and iridium together: the hold filled with 14 nickel among 58 units, the mining loop took it home to storage and went back, so a run is two trips. The other ores have no bid above 2 cr at our stations (books of 09:05 UTC): stored, not sold. The hand-in opens a tree of voidborn mastery missions on the same board: The Signal Protocol, Crystal Resonance Harvest, Deep Core Prospecting, Atmospheric Extraction: Setup, Material Synthesis: Basic, Network Commerce Protocol, Hardware Optimization: Cargo, Threat Neutralization Protocol (not flown: it asks to destroy a pirate, orders F2). requires.booked Network Expansion; max_ships 2 while the reef's nickel is the only read source within reach. Stamped 2026-11-16 09:34 UTC. 2026-11-16 12:34 UTC: off. The reef read nickel_ore 0 of 18,000 and platinum 0 of 7,000 at 11:54 UTC (data/scouting/gsc_0049.json; pilots of two other factions met there); a run started 11:16 UTC ended 'objectives not done' after 54.7 minutes, -338 cr. The only other nickel we read is Gliese 876 Belt, 659 of 12,000 among about 7,000 iron and carbon ore, 7 jumps (census 08:49 UTC): about 9 in 100 units mined would be nickel, three holds or more a run with no station to store at. On again when a census reads nickel at the reef; a field floor on the mine step is asked of the Fleet Admiral. 2026-11-17 11:40 UTC (Mercury, orders ENT-036 task 2, rules F34 and F35): on again as a test with one ship, the field moved to Rotanev Daylight Seam: 424 nickel ore and nothing else (census of 2026-11-17 00:46 UTC, table fields), 10 jumps by Node Beta, GSC-0027, GSC-0050, Brachium, Nightveil, Marfik, Regor, Groombridge 34 and Chalawan, none of them with a pirate on our record (observations, kind pirate). Not Gliese 876 Belt (635 nickel among iron and carbon, 7 jumps): a pirate stood at that belt at 05:13 UTC and 37 pirate battles are on the public record there (orders D9: our ships avoid pirates). Not Jadecove (609, pure nickel): its road crosses Gliese 876. A pure field fills the 20 in one hold. Read by Mining: admirals.log ENT-029. 2026-11-17 15:36 UTC: max_ships 1 -> 6. Rotanev Daylight Seam read 1,452 nickel of 20,000 (census of 14:03 UTC, scouting/rotanev.json; 424 at 00:46 UTC), enough for about 72 pilots at 20 each; the seven runs of 2026-11-17 (11:40 to 14:30 UTC) all paid 2,500 cr in 30.5 to 35.2 minutes with no loss; no pirate on record in the ten systems of its road in the 24 hours to 15:35 UTC (data/intel/sightings.jsonl); 213 pilots hold Network Expansion without this mission (data/fleet/onetime.json). 2026-11-17 19:50 UTC (Mercury, orders.log ENT-042): max_ships 6 -> 4 and min_left 60 nickel on the mine step. Rotanev's last census is of 14:03 UTC (1,452 nickel); 38 runs of ours since then, 37 paid, took about 740, and pilots of others mine there too, so about 700 may be left and nobody has read it. One run of 18:42 UTC mined 58 minutes and ended 'objectives not done'. A run that goes all the way round counts as done for its pilot (dispatch.py done_once), so a run on an emptied seam loses that pilot the mission for good (Mining's Deep Core runs on Markab, errors.log ENT-096). The floor closes the route only while a census younger than 90 minutes reads under 60 (dispatch.py field_floor); a fresh read of Rotanev is asked of Intel (admirals.log, this turn).
